scope: Assigned frozen item title and complete rendered ItemBody; excludes route navigation, dependency graph, and separate metadata Sources footer.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully; published-category audit workflow read.
review_method.rendering: Every receipt-listed assigned local PNG opened individually at original resolution with tools.view_image.
review_method.sources: Every assigned frozen snapshot and matching local HTML reviewed through the complete rendered ItemBody; source, HTML, and receipt-listed tile hashes checked.
review_method.boundary: Read-only local audit; no live website or network access; no item or publication-status changes.

typography_observations.observation: In some dependency-heavy prose, inline supplier links leave adjacent commas or closing parentheses visually isolated on a following line. The math remains legible and the links are rendered correctly; this is a minor reading-flow observation, not a confirmed rendering defect.

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.rationale: The statement names a fixed preparation, entangling gate, equatorial measurement, branch operator and outcome correction. A compact circuit would expose wire order and show how the measured branch produces the stated second-wire map.
concrete_labels_and_relations_to_draw_or: input wire 1 carries |ψ⟩=a|0⟩+c|1⟩; wire 2 starts at |+⟩
branch map on wire 2 is K_b=2^(-1/2) X^b J(α)
each branch probability is 1/2 and normalized output is X^b J(α)|ψ⟩
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.classification: editorial candidate; no mathematical error is confirmed

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.rationale: The theorem is explicitly a three-stage circuit transformation with named input, work and target registers. A wire diagram can make the register ownership, copy point and inverse action on XW immediately clear.
concrete_labels_and_relations_to_draw_or: X input |x⟩ and clean W input |0_W⟩ enter C
C maps |x,0_W⟩ to |x,g(x),r(x)⟩ with g(x) in designated m-bit work subregister
bitwise CNOT copies g(x) from W to distinct target register Y initially |y⟩
apply C^(-1) to XW while leaving Y untouched
overall map |x,y,0_W⟩ ↦ |x,y⊕g(x),0_W⟩; extends linearly to superpositions and reference registers
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.classification: editorial candidate; no mathematical error is confirmed
